input_contract: Implement the DSmall operations: init, append, truncate, compact, move, reset and borrowed data access. Inline capacity16 and maximum128 are part of the shared contract. Supply a fixed-capacity, typed byte-array allocator adapter that records requests and fails each requested allocation in turn; a host malloc adapter is an additional test only. Construct a separate fixed-capacity16-byte variant that always rejects spill. Compare its contract and owner size with DSmall. No string terminator, generic typed placement, automatic copy constructor or raw-struct move is supplied.
expected: Appending16 bytes performs no allocation. A failed17th byte preserves length16 and all bytes. Successful spill followed by move leaves the source empty and transfers exactly one allocation. Truncating to8 and compacting frees that allocation once; resetting both owners performs no second free.
independent_oracle: Run an operation-model generator over append lengths0,1,15,16,17,127,128,129; truncate, compact, move and reset. Preserve operation traces and independent byte-list state. Inject allocator failure at every spill and verify live allocation ownership, exact release counts and output state separately from callback instrumentation. Compile without a container/string library. Record sizeof/_Alignof on each available target. The header intentionally exposes fields for teaching, so forged state is outside the checked API contract and must be discussed.
status: authored; actual executions in source-bound campaign
verification_method: labs/dod/tests/verify_fixtures.py recomputes the bounded mathematical model independently of C
